decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the core modular sensing portfolio, it fits the firm’s announced platform direction and there is no clear evidence yet that weak uptake is anything more than an early-market effect.

This product builds directly on the established industrial module range and was given a dedicated webpage, so the firm has both strategic and visible commitment that would make management inclined to continue rather than withdraw in 2024.

A solid state relay module is closely aligned with the firm’s automation building-block system, and with recent launch timing and sunk development effort, management would likely persist while attributing any initial disappointment to the normal ramp-up period.

The server room monitoring kit extends the existing sensor-and-software ecosystem into a practical solution area, and in a growing firm and industry management would usually keep such a new adjacent offer on the market longer before judging it a failure.
